title: GPT-4V(ision) as A Social Media Analysis Engine
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the model's ability to detect multimodal hate speech, identify offensive subtext, stereotypes, and slurs targeting specific groups (including religious groups), and assess fake news and political ideology in posts that reference religious identities.
findings: GPT-4V demonstrated strong contextual awareness regarding religious sensitivities in multimodal contexts. It successfully identified antisemitic caricatures and symbols (e.g., Star of David, Menorah), recognized anti-Muslim hate speech even when obscured by misspellings (e.g., 'Muslyns'), and correctly fact-checked fake news that falsely claimed a U.S. state banned 'Muslim culture'. Furthermore, it detected when seemingly innocuous text combined with images of religious figures (e.g., the Islamic prophet Mohammed) conveyed underlying hostility or mockery.
